# I cannot compute this figure

The ruleset requires three inputs. Only two were provided:

| Required input | Status |
|---|---|
| (a) Good CN code in the table | **Missing.** "Steel goods" is not a CN code. |
| (b) Country of production listed for that good | Provided: India (listed for every CN code in the table) |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | Provided: 3,000 t |

## Why the CN code matters

The default SEE is selected by CN code and country together. Several table entries could be described as "steel goods," and their Indian SEE values differ a lot:

| CN code | Good | Default SEE, India (tCO2e/t) |
|---|---|---|
| 7206 10 00 | Ingots, of iron and non-alloy steel | 2.64 |
| 7207 11 90 | Semi-finished products of iron or non-alloy steel | 4.32 |
| 7214 20 00 | Bars and rods, of iron or non-alloy steel, with indentations… | 4.27 |

(7201, pig iron, is also listed for India at 2.53, although it is not usually classed as a steel good.)

Choosing one of these would be an estimate, which the ruleset does not allow.

## What I need

Please provide the **CN code** of the goods. If the 3,000 t covers more than one CN code, give the tonnage for each code. I can then calculate:

Embedded emissions = SEE (CN code, India) × quantity (t), rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
